decisions.reason: Certified gasketed plate heat exchangers for HVAC sit very close to the core offer, so the firm's in-house R&D and existing know-how let it interpret results and refine the line.
The marine box cooler builds on established competence and is reported as well-known with a major market share in water cooling, giving strong reasons to keep it.
The marine cooling unit extends related marine cooling knowledge and has its own web page, so the firm can assimilate feedback and improve it.
The compact oil cooler line draws on the firm's existing heat exchange engineering, which supports learning from early results within its R&D-active setting.
Finned tubes for air coolers are a core component technology the firm understands well, and they are presented prominently on their own page.
Enhanced heat exchanger tubes build directly on the firm's tube and heat transfer know-how, fit its R&D and EU-project experience, and are well suited to continued improvement.
